notes: Task 2 complete: tests/setup/electron-mock.ts + tests/electron-chrome-windows.test.ts landed per Phase 0 Task 2. Found and fixed a real bug in the plan's own test boilerplate -- a top-level `import { electronMock } from './setup/electron-mock'` combined with `vi.resetModules()` in beforeEach goes stale, because resetModules() also invalidates the vi.mock factory's own cached dynamic import of that file, producing a second disconnected electronMock instance. Fixed by re-importing electron-mock.ts INSIDE the test body after resetModules(), documented in both committed files. IMPORTANT for Task 3 (and 4-9 when their turn comes): do not copy the plan's literal top-level-import-plus-beforeEach(resetModules) boilerplate verbatim -- follow the corrected pattern in tests/electron-chrome-windows.test.ts instead.
